RAHUL DILIP GHODERAO
Mumbai, Maharashtra | ghoderaorahul1@gmail.com | +91 9860786575 

5+ years of experience managing end-to-end procurement, vendor management and onboarding, invoice
reconciliation and validation, cost control, and stakeholder coordination across multinational environments. Proven
expertise in SAP Ariba, Purchase Requisition (PR), Purchase Order (PO) processing, contract compliance, budget
tracking. Demonstrated success in managing 300+ annual procurement transactions, ensuring SLA adherence, and
supporting cross-functional teams across Finance, Operations, and Vendors

SUMMARY

WORK EXPERIENCE
Administration & Procurement Executive Aug 2024 - Present 
Tata Consultancy Services - Global leading IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization.

• Executed end-to-end procurement operations through SAP Ariba, managing 25–35 Purchase Orders (POs) monthly (300+
annually) while ensuring compliance with procurement policies and SLA 
• Performed Purchase Requisition (PR) and Purchase Order (PO) processing, validating vendor master data, contracts,
budgets, approval matrices, and cost allocations.
• Verified and reconciled 40–60 vendor invoices per month, minimizing payment delays and discrepancies 
• Coordinated with vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure timely procurement, service continuity, approvals, and
seamless delivery across global operations.
• Oversaw AMC renewals, contract amendments, lease agreements, utility consumption monitoring
and implementation of housekeeping and security manpower minimum wages
• Coordinated office infrastructure projects, workspace modifications, and asset deployment activities.
• Acted as a key liaison between Procurement, Finance, Business Units, and Vendors to resolve issues.
• Prepared monthly and executed CDS activities (SWON/WON), ensuring accurate financial cost allocation.
• Maintained procurement documentation and compliance standards, supporting successful audits and governance.

Administration & Procurement Executive
Aug 2021 - Apr 2024EOSGlobe –  Outsourced customer experience and back-office support to the businesses.

• Managed procurement of materials (Opex and Capex), services, IT assets, and software licenses with cost efficiency and
timely delivery.
• Executed Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) in compliance with organizational procurement policies
and approval procedures.
• Coordinated with vendors, obtained quotations, negotiated commercial terms, and maintained supplier relationships to
ensure optimal pricing and service quality.
• Vendor invoices and maintained procurement documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal controls.
• Managed monthly rental data for IT assets, servers, laptops, and desktops, ensuring proper asset and cost tracking.
• Prepared and maintained monthly Cost Per Seat (CPS) reports, supporting budget monitoring and management review.
• Processed corporate payments for software subscriptions, cloud services, travel bookings, hosting/domain services, and
facility-related vendors.
• Supported facility management and other procurement-related operational requirements.

Procurement Executive | Supply Chain Executive

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Finance 2024 – Present

Swayam Siddhi College of Management and Research (Mumbai University, Mumbai, India)
Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)
 N.R. Bhagat Junior & Senior College (Mumbai University, Mumbai, India)

2019 – 2022

SKILLS

• ERP SAP Ariba • Cost Control and Budget Tracking • Strong Negotiation and cost saving  • Audit Compliance
• Microsoft Excel (Advanced: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) • MS Office Suite • Problem Solving & Issue
Resolution • Time Management & Multi-Tasking • Vendor Management • Asset Management
LANGUAGES

• English (Fluent)         • Hindi (Fluent)            • Marathi (Native)               • German (A1)
